title: GDHCN DID trustlist v2 client
description: Restates GDHCN Trustlists (DID), Trustlists 2.0.0; GDHCN Trustlists (DID), DID trustlists structure; GDHCN Trustlists (DID), Example DID documents; Endpoints, Trustlist Distribution Endpoints; W3C DID Core.

statements.label: GDHCN DID trustlist v2 client
statements.requirement: The library SHALL provide a TrustListProvider for the GDHCN DID trustlist v2. It SHALL support the embedded and reference variants, the DEV, UAT and PROD environments, and the hierarchical root/$domain/$participant/$usage paths with "-" as a wildcard. It SHALL read DSCs from verificationMethod publicKeyJwk (x5c), with the kid as the fragment.

sources.quote: Note that "-" character can be used as a wildcard on each sublevel of root.
Specific keys use base64 encoded key id (kid) as identifier, It is represented as fragments (#) in verification method id
